items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: The manager approached me and I took a trio to the Onyx which consisted of Johnny, Hank D'Amico and me.

ctx.x: Mm hmm. So they wanted a trio in the Onyx. The manager approached me and I took a trio to the Onyx which consisted of Johnny, Hank D'Amico and me. We went in there. Hank was, he wasn't a alcoholic but every

night he'd have to have that little taste. So, he'd run up a tab, so at the end of the week, when I would get the money, Hank's would be minus whatever it was. Mine would be minus maybe $8.00 for the whole week of drinking. Johnny's was the only one where he would get full salary, so we used to laugh about that all the time. So when I got paid I'd give Johnny his envelope, and when with Hank, I'd say wait a minute, Hank, we've got to figure up all these tabs that you have had. But that was a good trio. Frank…
